_comment: #412 - names OnePageRules has changed, and index entries that are not real books.
Army Forge's official-book index is keyed by NAME, and --rebuild-books reuses an existing
book's file by matching that name. When OPR renames a faction the match fails, so the rebuild
writes a second file under the new name and leaves the old one behind as a stale duplicate.
'renames' maps the name WE bundled the book under to the name OPR publishes today. The rebuild
keeps the original file, adopts OPR's current name inside it, and records the old one in the
book's previousNames so already-saved armies and Army Forge share links still resolve
(BookFile.MatchesFactionName). 'system' is the slug the rename applies to; a rename with no
system applies to every system, which is what the 3.6.0 daemon renames needed - the same
faction was renamed in Grimdark Future, Firefight, Age of Fantasy and Skirmish at once.
'skip' lists index entries that are not books: OPR 3.6.0 split the daemon books into four
per-god books each and left the parent entry in the index with zero units. --rebuild-books also
skips any zero-unit book on its own, so this list is for naming them rather than for the skip.

skip.why: empty parent entry since OPR 3.6.0 - split into the four Daemons of X books
